tr.description: Kauçuk bitkisi bakımı: parlak dolaylı ışık, sulamadan önce hafif kuruma, süt özsuyuna dikkat, hava daldırması ve ASPCA kaydı.
tr.imageAlt: Kalın, koyu bordo yaprakları ve yeni yaprağı saran kırmızı kılıfıyla kauçuk bitkisi
tr.caption: Fotoğraf: Ficus elastica, Rosalinda Melendrez, iNaturalist üzerinden, CC BY 4.0. Yeniden boyutlandırıldı.

atAGlance.light: Parlak dolaylı ışık; alacalı formlar daha çok ışık ister
atAGlance.watering: Sulamalar arasında harç biraz kurusun; kışın ancak hafif nemli tut
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCA kedi ve köpekler için toksik olarak listeler (Indian rubber plant)

en.description: Rubber plant care: bright indirect light, a slight dry-down before watering, sap safety, air layering and ASPCA pet status.
en.imageAlt: Rubber plant with thick, dark burgundy leaves and a red sheath around a new leaf
en.caption: Photo: Ficus elastica by Rosalinda Melendrez, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Resized.

atAGlance.light: Bright indirect light; variegated forms need more light
atAGlance.watering: Let the mix dry slightly between waterings; keep it only just moist in winter
atAGlance.petSafety: Listed as toxic to cats and dogs by the ASPCA (Indian rubber plant)

es.description: Cuidados del ficus elástica: luz indirecta brillante, secado ligero antes de regar, precaución con el látex, acodo aéreo y estado según la ASPCA.
es.imageAlt: Ficus elástica de hojas gruesas color burdeos oscuro y una vaina roja alrededor de la hoja nueva
es.caption: Foto: Ficus elastica de Rosalinda Melendrez, vía iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Redimensionada.

atAGlance.light: Luz indirecta brillante; las formas variegadas necesitan más luz
atAGlance.watering: Deja secar un poco el sustrato entre riegos; en invierno, apenas húmedo
atAGlance.temperature: Por encima de 13 °C; sin corrientes frías
atAGlance.petSafety: La ASPCA lo incluye como tóxico para gatos y perros (Indian rubber plant)

de.description: Gummibaum pflegen: helles indirektes Licht, vor dem Gießen leicht antrocknen lassen, Vorsicht beim Milchsaft, Abmoosen und ASPCA-Einstufung.
de.imageAlt: Gummibaum mit dicken, dunkel weinroten Blättern und roter Hülle um ein neues Blatt
de.caption: Foto: Ficus elastica von Rosalinda Melendrez, über iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Verkleinert.

atAGlance.light: Hell und indirekt; panaschierte Sorten brauchen mehr Licht
atAGlance.watering: Leicht antrocknen lassen; im Winter nur knapp feucht halten
atAGlance.petSafety: Von der ASPCA als giftig für Katzen und Hunde geführt (Indian rubber plant)

pt.description: Cuidados com a falsa-seringueira: luz indireta clara, secagem leve antes de regar, cuidado com o látex, alporquia e a classificação da ASPCA.
pt.imageAlt: Falsa-seringueira de folhas grossas cor vinho-escuro e uma bainha vermelha envolvendo a folha nova
pt.caption: Foto: Ficus elastica de Rosalinda Melendrez, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Redimensionada.

atAGlance.light: Luz indireta clara; formas variegadas pedem mais luz
atAGlance.watering: Deixe secar um pouco entre regas; no inverno, só levemente úmido
atAGlance.temperature: Acima de 13 °C; sem correntes de ar frio
atAGlance.petSafety: A ASPCA lista como tóxica para gatos e cães (Indian rubber plant)

fr.description: Entretien du caoutchouc : lumière vive indirecte, léger séchage avant d’arroser, prudence avec le latex, marcottage aérien et statut ASPCA.
fr.imageAlt: Caoutchouc aux feuilles épaisses bordeaux foncé et à la gaine rouge autour d’une nouvelle feuille
fr.caption: Photo : Ficus elastica de Rosalinda Melendrez, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Redimensionnée.

atAGlance.light: Lumière vive indirecte ; les formes panachées en demandent plus
atAGlance.watering: Laisser sécher légèrement entre deux arrosages ; à peine frais en hiver
atAGlance.temperature: Au-dessus de 13 °C ; pas de courants d’air froid
atAGlance.petSafety: Classé toxique pour les chats et les chiens par l’ASPCA (Indian rubber plant)

ja.description: インドゴムノキの育て方。明るい間接光、水やり前の軽い乾燥、樹液への注意、取り木、ASPCAのペット情報を紹介します。
ja.imageAlt: 厚く濃いバーガンディー色の葉と、新葉を包む赤い托葉のあるインドゴムノキ
ja.caption: 写真：Ficus elastica、撮影：Rosalinda Melendrez。iNaturalistより、CC BY 4.0。サイズ変更済み。

atAGlance.light: 明るい間接光。斑入りにはより多くの光が必要
atAGlance.watering: 水やりの間に少し乾かす。冬はかすかな湿り気を保つ程度
atAGlance.temperature: 13℃（55℉）より高く保ち、冷たいすきま風を避ける
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCAは猫・犬に有毒と掲載（項目名Indian rubber plant）

ko.description: 인도고무나무 관리: 밝은 간접광, 살짝 마른 뒤 물주기, 수액 주의, 취목과 ASPCA의 반려동물 관련 분류를 알아보세요.
ko.imageAlt: 두꺼운 짙은 자주색 잎과 새 잎을 감싼 붉은 잎집이 보이는 인도고무나무
ko.caption: 사진: Ficus elastica — 촬영: Rosalinda Melendrez, iNaturalist 제공, CC BY 4.0. 크기를 조정했습니다.

atAGlance.light: 밝은 간접광. 무늬종은 더 많은 빛이 필요합니다
atAGlance.watering: 물주기 사이 흙을 약간 말리고 겨울에는 간신히 촉촉한 정도로 유지하세요
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCA가 고양이와 개에게 유독한 식물로 분류했습니다(Indian rubber plant)

it.imageAlt: Ficus elastica con foglie spesse color bordeaux scuro e guaina rossa intorno a una nuova foglia
it.caption: Foto: Ficus elastica di Rosalinda Melendrez, tramite iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Ridimensionata.

atAGlance.light: Luce intensa indiretta; le forme variegate ne richiedono di più
atAGlance.watering: Lascia asciugare leggermente; mantieni appena umido in inverno
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCA: tossico per gatti e cani nella voce “Indian rubber plant”

it.description: Cura del ficus elastica: luce indiretta, lieve asciugatura prima dell’acqua, cautela con la linfa, margotte e informazioni ASPCA sugli animali.

zh-Hant.imageAlt: 橡膠樹厚實亮澤的深綠葉片與包住新葉的紅色托葉
zh-Hant.caption: 照片： Ficus elastica，攝影：Rosalinda Melendrez，來源：iNaturalist， CC BY 4.0. 已調整尺寸。

atAGlance.light: 明亮間接光；避免強烈午後日照
atAGlance.watering: 生長期讓介質稍乾再澆；冬季只維持微濕
atAGlance.petSafety: 對貓狗有風險；ASPCA 俗名條目使用另一榕屬學名

zh-Hant.description: 橡膠樹照護指南：明亮間接光、澆水與溫度檢查、修剪和高壓繁殖，並釐清汁液刺激及寵物資料的學名差異。
